data: The Thomas Double Bed is a harmonious fusion of sculptural elegance and inviting comfort. Its distinctive headboard, reminiscent of an embracing shell, features soft upholstery accentuated by wide quilted stitching, balancing bold contours with refined detail. The raised bed frame, upholstered to match the headboard, is supported by sleek metal feet with a unique central slit, creating a striking contrast between rounded upholstery and angular supports. Customisable in synthetic leather, fabric, micro nubuck, or soft leather, with feet in bronze or graphite embossed lacquered steel, Thomas offers unparalleled versatility. Slats are integrated into the structure.
